title: The swap says COMPLETED but the payer has NOT been made whole
description: A second swap on the same corridor reaches COMPLETED — the beneficiary was paid in full — yet residue_status reads RETURN_FAILED. The 5.43 CRC slippage buffer is stranded on the Hub swap signer and the payer is that much short. A client asserting only on status would report this payment as clean.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. This is the single most important negative case in Scenario B and it is invisible unless a client reads residue_status. The residue leg is a SEPARATE bridge position from the settlement one, so nothing about the beneficiary's credit tells you whether it succeeded. Conformance must assert residue reconciliation, not merely status == COMPLETED.
